title: Understanding MSE
text: To calculate the Mean Squared Error (MSE), you need to find the difference between the observed values and the predicted values from the regression line. Then, square these differences and find their average.

title: Identifying Residuals
text: Look at the graph and identify the observed tip values and the corresponding predicted values on the line for each temperature. The residuals are the differences between these observed and predicted values.
